integrity: Proof independently supplemented by exact arithmetic comparison on 3256 coprime pairs. Finite enumeration alone is not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Coprime two-generator inclusion-exclusion polynomials only. No external audit; equivalent formulas may occur in uninspected work. Prior word formulas implicitly determine coefficients but no covering direct multiplicity or square-slope assertion was identified.
title: Complete gap-multiplicity law and square-slope structure for binary inclusion-exclusion polynomials
